observations: Gold-colored game console held in a hand.
The PlayStation logo (interlocking P and S) is visible on the top surface.
The text 'PS4' is printed on the front edge of the console.
The device has the characteristic two-tier 'Slim' profile of a PlayStation 4.
The console is shown in a commercial or warehouse setting with other units and boxes visible.
The gold finish appears to be in good cosmetic condition on the visible surfaces.

claims.evidence: Only the top and front are shown; the condition of ports and the underside is unknown.
The gold color is a specific limited edition release for the PS4 Slim.
No controller is visible in the provided photo.
No accessories are visible in the provided photo.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or could have a hardware failure like the 'Blue Light of Death'.
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the home screen and launching a game.

risks.risk: The 'follow come' (original) gold controller may be missing or faulty.
risks.proof: A photo of the matching gold controller and a video of it in use.

risks.risk: The internal hard drive capacity is unknown (500GB vs 1TB).
risks.proof: A screenshot of the 'Storage' menu in the system settings.

risks.risk: The optical disc drive may be unable to read discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted and recognized by the system.
risks.if_unproven: As having a faulty disc drive.

proof_requests: Photo of the controller and any included cables/accessories.
Video of the console turned on and displaying the home menu on a screen.
Screenshot of the System Storage settings.
Photo of the sticker on the bottom or back showing the model and serial numbers.
response.reason: The seller claims a 'follow come' controller and accessories are included, but none are pictured. For a special edition console, the matching controller is a significant part of the value. There is also no proof that the console is functional.
